title: App on port 3000 or 5000 times out once its DNS record is proxied through Cloudflare
symptoms: Same port works with the record set to DNS only
Ports 443 and 8443 work while 3000 does not
cause: Proxied records only accept traffic on a fixed port list: 80, 8080, 8880, 2052, 2082, 2086, 2095 for HTTP and 443, 2053, 2083, 2087, 2096, 8443 for HTTPS. Anything else needs DNS only or Spectrum.
fix: Serve the app on a supported port behind a reverse proxy, or set the record to DNS only.
affected: Cloudflare proxied (orange cloud) records on all plans; arbitrary ports need Spectrum (all ports on Enterprise)
